findings.description: MainForm renders FormWrapper without openForm and sets isOpen when its editor is focused or has content. Focusing the main comment editor now reads undefined.in_reply_to_snippet and throws, crashing the comments UI. Restore the removed guard: `const isReplyToReply = !!openForm?.in_reply_to_snippet;`.
findings.failureMode: A member focuses MainForm's editor, setting isOpen=true while openForm is undefined; FormWrapper throws TypeError during rendering.
findings.title: Preserve the optional openForm guard

findings.description: A signed-in member with a name but null/empty expertise now gets a read-only editor in comment, reply and edit forms. Expertise is optional, and focusEditor only prompts members without a name, so this user cannot type or edit a comment. Use !!memberName instead of !!member?.expertise; the same correction also keeps nameless members from typing before providing a name.
findings.failureMode: member.name is set and member.expertise is null or empty; Form's effect calls editor.setEditable(false), leaving an otherwise eligible commenting member unable to type.
findings.title: Gate editor editability on the member's name

findings.description: When replying to reply B under comment A, ReplyForm receives A as parent and B's id in openForm.in_reply_to_id. Sending parent.id makes the server discard the nested reply reference because A is not a child of itself. The saved reply loses its reply-to snippet/link and B's author is not notified. Restore openForm.in_reply_to_id and its callback dependency.
findings.failureMode: A user replies to nested reply B under comment A; the payload sets both parent_id and in_reply_to_id to A.id, so comments-service.replyToComment clears in_reply_to_id and never sends the in_reply_to notification to B's author.
findings.title: Keep the selected reply as in_reply_to_id

findings.description: Putting `pr-2` before `mt-[-16px]` violates AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md mandate 15's standard Tailwind ordering. `yarn --cwd apps/comments-ui lint` fails at this line with `tailwindcss/classnames-order`. Restore `className='mt-[-16px] pr-2'`.
findings.failureMode: Running yarn --cwd apps/comments-ui lint exits with Invalid Tailwind CSS classnames order at reply-form.tsx:47; violates AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md rule 15.
findings.title: Restore the required Tailwind class order

findings.description: getRecordings is async, so this returns a Promise in data, which serializes as {} instead of a recordings array and produces TS2740. Its rejections also escape Nest's error handling: an authorized owner requesting recordings for a booking without a Cal Video reference can crash the API process under default Node settings. Restore the deleted statement `const recordings = await this.calVideoService.getRecordings(bookingUid);` to resolve the data and propagate the service's 404 normally.
findings.failureMode: Authorized recordings requests return a Promise as data; a booking without a Cal Video reference makes that unobserved Promise reject, crashing Node instead of returning the service's 404.
findings.title: Await recordings and propagate service errors

findings.description: @calcom/features/bookings/lib/BookingRepository does not exist; BookingRepository lives under bookings/repositories. TypeScript resolves type-only imports even when unused, so the platform-types tsc build fails with TS2307 before API builds/tests can run. Remove this unused import.
findings.failureMode: Building @calcom/platform-types resolves the newly added type import and fails because packages/features/bookings/lib/BookingRepository.ts is absent.
findings.title: Remove the import from a nonexistent repository path

findings.description: BookingPbacGuard reads request.user and throws UnauthorizedException when it is absent. It now executes before ApiAuthGuard populates request.user, so even a booking organizer with a valid API key gets 401 and cannot retrieve transcripts. Run ApiAuthGuard and BookingUidGuard before BookingPbacGuard, as on the recordings and conferencing-sessions routes.
findings.failureMode: GET transcripts with a valid owner's bearer API key reaches BookingPbacGuard before request.user exists and is rejected with 401.
findings.title: Authenticate before running transcript PBAC

findings.description: Changing this GET route from BOOKING_READ to BOOKING_WRITE makes PermissionsGuard reject a managed-user access token whose OAuth client has only booking-read permission, even when the user owns the booking. Restore BOOKING_READ, matching transcripts and conferencing-sessions; BookingPbacGuard already enforces booking access.
findings.failureMode: A booking organizer uses an OAuth managed-user access token tied to a read-only platform client; GET recordings returns 403 because BOOKING_WRITE is required instead of BOOKING_READ.
findings.title: Keep recordings on the booking-read permission

findings.description: The newly enabled recordings test uses jest.spyOn, violating AGENTS.md §8's requirement that all tests use Vitest APIs. Run this test with Vitest and use vi.spyOn instead.
findings.failureMode: New active recordings test uses a Jest-specific API rather than the mandated Vitest mocking API.
findings.title: Use Vitest for the recordings mock

findings.description: The newly enabled transcripts test also uses jest.spyOn, violating AGENTS.md §8's requirement that all tests use Vitest APIs. Run this test with Vitest and replace this separate mock with vi.spyOn.
findings.failureMode: New active transcripts test uses a Jest-specific API rather than the mandated Vitest mocking API.
findings.title: Use Vitest for the transcripts mock

findings.description: `scheduling.init()` forwards its argument unchanged to post-scheduling, which unconditionally reads `options.apiUrl` after loading the adapter. Calling it without options throws a TypeError on normal boot; `bootGhost` catches it and shuts down the server. Restore the options object containing the absolute admin API URL.
findings.failureMode: On a normal boot with the default scheduling adapter, post-scheduling receives undefined options, throws when reading apiUrl, and the boot error path shuts Ghost down.
findings.title: Pass the required options to the scheduler

findings.description: The new note instructs developers to run `npm install <package>`, violating repository mandate 23 (AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md), which requires Yarn v1 for dependency-management commands, including documentation. Replace it with the appropriate `yarn add <package>` command.
findings.failureMode: The changed code comment documents an npm package operation forbidden by the mandatory Yarn v1 rule.
findings.title: Use Yarn in the dependency-installation note

findings.description: The global mock previously returned an array for `t(key, { returnObjects: true })`; the new fallback always returns a string. Rendering the self-hosted pricing feature List with the global mock now makes `features.map(...)` throw `TypeError`. Restore the `returnObjects` array fallback in the helper while allowing custom arrays.
findings.failureMode: Render self-hosted pricing List using global react-i18next mock; returnObjects produces a string and features.map throws.
findings.title: Preserve array results for returnObjects

findings.description: The new global Trans replacement drops `components` entirely. Rendering the existing `installModal.fromTrustSource` translation with a `trustSource` span loses that span; embedded links/buttons such as EmptyElement's `shareLink`/`testLink` likewise disappear, making their interactions untestable with the shared mock. The base setup renders the span. Render supplied components alongside the key/text instead of discarding them.
findings.failureMode: A component supplied through Trans.components is never rendered; its link or button cannot be queried or clicked in a test using the shared mock.
findings.title: Preserve components supplied to Trans

findings.description: The former global `useTranslation(defaultNs)` forwarded its namespace to `t`, but this factory ignores all hook arguments. Under the global mock, `useTranslation('billing').t('plansCommon.taxTip')` now returns `plansCommon.taxTip` instead of `billing.plansCommon.taxTip`, and namespace-qualified custom translations are missed. Accept the namespace and pass it to `createTFunction`.
findings.failureMode: Calling the mocked useTranslation with a default namespace returns unqualified keys and misses qualified custom values.
findings.title: Forward the hook's default namespace

findings.description: The new interface violates mandatory AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md rule 10 and fails the configured `ts/consistent-type-definitions` rule: `pnpm lint test/i18n-mock.ts` exits with an error at this declaration. Use `type TranslationMap = Record<string, string | string[]>` instead.
findings.failureMode: New TypeScript declaration violates mandatory type-alias rule.
findings.title: Use a type alias for TranslationMap

findings.description: The setup only mocks `react-i18next`; `useMixedTranslation(locale)` still calls the real `i18n.getFixedT`. For example, with `en-US`, `t('category.all', { ns: 'plugin' })` returns `All`, not `plugin.category.all`. Tests following this guidance to omit their locale-specific stub therefore get real translations. Correct this claim here, in `.claude/skills/frontend-testing/references/mocking.md:64`, and in `.claude/skills/frontend-testing/assets/component-test.template.tsx:31`.
findings.failureMode: Tests following guidance to omit a local mock for useMixedTranslation with an explicit locale receive real translated text instead of mock keys.
findings.title: Do not describe useMixedTranslation as globally mocked

findings.description: No global mock for `@/context/i18n` is registered. `useGetLanguage` still reads `localeAtom`; with `zh-Hans` it returns `zh_Hans`, not the promised `en-US`. Tests omitting their locale stub per this guidance get locale-dependent output. Correct this claim here, in `.claude/skills/frontend-testing/references/mocking.md:65`, and in `.claude/skills/frontend-testing/assets/component-test.template.tsx:31`.
findings.failureMode: A test omitting its useGetLanguage stub per the new documentation receives zh_Hans for a zh-Hans localeAtom, rather than fixed en-US.
findings.title: Do not promise a fixed locale from useGetLanguage

findings.description: This comment promises that the unqualified key wins, but lines 16–21 check the namespace-qualified key first. Given both `save: 'Save'` and `'common.save': 'Confirm'`, `t('save', { ns: 'common' })` returns `Confirm`, contrary to this public helper documentation. Update the comment to describe namespace-first precedence.
findings.failureMode: Callers supplying both namespaced and unqualified translations get the opposite precedence from the public helper documentation.
findings.title: Document the actual translation lookup order

findings.description: While the lazy React Scan chunk is pending in development, every locale displays the hardcoded English text `Loading devtools...`. AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md rule 11 requires all frontend user-facing strings to come from `web/i18n/en-US/` via `useTranslation` with an explicit namespace. Add a translation key and use it in the fallback instead of the literal.
findings.failureMode: The Suspense fallback displays an untranslated English message and violates the mandatory frontend i18n rule.
findings.title: Translate the devtools loading message

findings.description: The new import-rejection path calls `console.error` in a frontend component, violating mandatory repository rule 25, which requires removing console statements or replacing them with proper logging. Remove this call while retaining the null-component fallback.
findings.failureMode: A rejected React Scan import reaches a console statement that violates the mandatory frontend no-console rule.
findings.title: Remove the prohibited console output

findings.description: For a proactive firing with no matching event and nonempty automation.actions, triggers.act() publishes automation.triggered and passes its ID to TriggeredAction with triggering_event=None. This new check then raises ValidationError before any actions are queued, including state-specific actions in the same list. Remove this validator's dependency on triggering_event; the state-change ID is valid without an original event.
findings.failureMode: A proactive Firing with triggering_event=None and nonempty automation.actions raises ValidationError in triggers.act instead of publishing actions.
findings.title: Allow state-change links for eventless proactive firings

findings.description: On ActionFailed, this replaces `related=related_resources` with the unenriched result list. Consequently action.triggered loses both the existing triggering-event relation and the new automation-triggered-event relation, even though action.failed receives them. This also fails the failure-event tests. Pass related_resources here, as succeed() does.
findings.failureMode: Any failed action with a triggering_event emits action.triggered without its source event relations; with a state change ID it also loses the new state change relation.
findings.title: Keep source links on failed actions' triggered events

findings.description: For a Firing containing both Triggered and Resolved, primary_state_change_event_id is the triggered event ID. The actions_on_resolve tuple therefore links automation.action.* to automation.triggered even though the action's triggering_event is automation.resolved. Pass resolved_event.id for these actions so the new relation identifies the state change that actually prompted them.
findings.failureMode: A Firing containing both supported trigger states queues resolve-specific actions with a relation to the wrong state-change event.
findings.title: Link resolve actions to their resolved state-change event

findings.description: This field_validator reads info.data['triggering_event'] to check automation_triggered_event_id against another field. AGENTS.md rule 8 explicitly requires @model_validator for cross-field validation. Any retained cross-field invariant must be checked with a model validator over validated fields, not an individual field validator.
findings.failureMode: The added cross-field field_validator violates the mandatory model_validator rule.
findings.title: Use a model validator for cross-field validation

findings.description: The new tracing guide says action.triggered is emitted when an action starts, but actions.consumer awaits action.act() before calling succeed() or fail(), and those methods emit both events. A slow or hung webhook has no action.triggered event while running, and an unexpected exception emits none. Document this post-action emission behavior rather than promising a start-time event.
findings.failureMode: Users looking for the documented start event during a long-running/hung action will see no action.triggered event; the newly documented emission timing is false.
findings.title: Correct the documented timing of action.triggered emission

findings.description: The new table describes triggering-event as the original event, but triggers.act() sets triggering_event to automation.triggered for actions_on_trigger and automation.resolved for actions_on_resolve. Those action events therefore link to a state-change event, not directly to the original external event. Document the distinction so users follow the correct event when tracing state-specific actions.
findings.failureMode: An automation with actions_on_trigger emits action events whose triggering-event related resource points to automation.triggered rather than the original event advertised by the new table.
findings.title: Describe triggering-event links for state-specific actions

findings.description: Reading the parent pool discards `item.new_value`. IterationNode executes assigners in a deep-copied pool and forwards their success events before syncing the parent pool. With an assigner followed by a slow child node, this lookup returns the old value, writes it to the database, and no later assigner event fixes it. Use the event's new_value when constructing the Variable to persist; the live pool should supply metadata only.
findings.failureMode: An advanced-chat iteration sets a conversation variable and then runs a slow LLM/tool before iteration completion. The parent layer observes the assigner's success while its own pool still has the old variable, so the database retains the old value for the next chat even though the child assigner succeeded.
findings.title: Persist the value carried by the success event

findings.description: A missing ConversationVariable or failed database commit raises here, but EventManager._notify_layers catches all layer exceptions and continues. The assigner and graph still report success although the value was never persisted (and the remaining updates are skipped). Previously this exception became a node failure. Handle persistence errors through the graph failure/command path rather than letting the observer swallow them.
findings.failureMode: During a chat an assigner changes a value but its row is missing or the commit fails; EventManager logs and suppresses the updater exception, so a successful response advertises a conversation-variable update that is lost on the next request.
findings.title: Make persistence failures fail the workflow

findings.description: Replacing `with Session(db.engine) as session:` with a bare Session leaves it unclosed, including when a missing row raises ConversationVariableNotFoundError. Repeated failed updates can retain transactions/connections until garbage collection and exhaust the pool. This also violates mandate 6; wrap the query and commit in the required session context manager.
findings.failureMode: A variable is deleted before persistence (or a nonexistent id is supplied); update raises without closing or rolling back its Session, leaking a checked-out database connection across repeated calls.
findings.title: Restore context-managed database sessions

findings.description: The new `__init__` only forwards the same four arguments to Node.__init__, with no subclass-specific initialization. Mandate 21 permits dunder overrides only when necessary, and the base constructor already supplies this behavior. Remove this override and inherit Node.__init__ instead.
findings.failureMode: The pass-through v2 constructor violates mandatory rule 21 against unnecessary dunder overrides.
findings.title: Remove the redundant initializer

findings.description: The newly introduced `__init__` lacks `-> None`, contrary to AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md mandate 1's explicit return-annotation requirement for all Python functions. Add the return annotation; basedpyright accepting an inferred constructor return does not satisfy the mandate.
findings.failureMode: The new v2 initializer violates mandatory Python annotation rule 1 by omitting its return annotation.
findings.title: Annotate the new initializer's return type

findings.description: This new warning logs only the selector, without tenant/app/workflow identifiers. Mandate 23 requires those identifiers in backend log context, so concurrent executions cannot attribute this discarded update to its workflow. Add execution context to this log (the runtime system-variable view exposes app_id and workflow_id).
findings.failureMode: An invalid-selector event is skipped and the log contains no tenant/app/workflow context, violating mandatory observability rule 23.
findings.title: Include workflow context in invalid-selector logs

findings.description: The missing-variable warning contains only selector=%s and then discards the persistence update. It violates mandate 23's requirement for tenant/app/workflow identifiers in backend logs, preventing attribution across simultaneous workflows. Include execution context in this log, using the app/workflow ids available on the system-variable view.
findings.failureMode: A missing conversation variable causes a skipped persistence write whose log lacks the execution identifiers required by observability rule 23.
findings.title: Include workflow context in missing-variable logs

findings.description: This new test omits its return annotation. AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md mandate 1 requires explicit parameter and return annotations on all Python functions, including tests. Add `-> None` to this definition; tests being excluded from basedpyright does not exempt them from the mandate.
findings.failureMode: The new test definition violates mandatory Python annotation rule 1; compliance requires an explicit None return annotation.
findings.title: Annotate the persistence test's return type

findings.description: The new `test_skips_when_outputs_missing` has no return annotation, violating AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md mandate 1 for all Python function definitions. Add `-> None`; the type checker's exclusion of tests is not a waiver of this requirement.
findings.failureMode: The new missing-output test violates mandatory annotation rule 1 by omitting its return annotation.
findings.title: Annotate the missing-output test's return type

findings.description: The new `test_skips_non_assigner_nodes` omits its return type. AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md mandate 1 applies to test functions too and requires explicit return annotations. Add `-> None` to this definition.
findings.failureMode: The new node-filter test violates mandatory annotation rule 1 by omitting its return annotation.
findings.title: Annotate the node-filter test's return type

findings.description: The new `test_skips_non_conversation_variables` lacks a return annotation. This violates AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md mandate 1, which covers all Python function definitions without a test exemption. Add `-> None`.
findings.failureMode: The new conversation-filter test violates mandatory annotation rule 1 by omitting its return annotation.
findings.title: Annotate the conversation-filter test's return type

findings.description: This added test has no return annotation. AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md mandate 1 requires explicit return annotations on every Python function, including tests. Declare `-> None` here.
findings.failureMode: The added node-factory test violates mandatory Python annotation rule 1.
findings.title: Annotate the new factory test's return type

findings.description: The new bookingUrl state is initialized to an empty string and setBookingUrl is never called. Opening an existing event type with a valid API bookingUrl therefore makes both Preview and Copy Link always show the unavailable-URL error, even after saving, and BasicsTab always displays the personal-account fallback. Set the URL from the loaded event type (and refresh it after updates).
findings.failureMode: Existing saved event type successfully loads, but Preview/Copy Link reject because local bookingUrl remains empty; organization URL prefix is also never used.
findings.title: Populate bookingUrl when loading event type data

findings.description: When /me fails (for example with 401 or a timeout), this throws a bare Error with no code, status, or cause, so the detail screen's safeLogError loses the actionable failure. It violates AGENTS.md rule 10, and discarding the catch binding on line 1659 also produces a Biome noUnusedVariables error. Use the required structured error with the original error as its cause; that fixes both lines.
findings.failureMode: A failed /me request is converted to an uncategorized error; caller logs cannot distinguish authentication failure, timeout, or API status, and required typed error contract is breached.
findings.title: Preserve structured errors from username lookup

findings.description: The added suppression bypasses noExplicitAny on the Safari fallback using the claim that browserAction is absent from Chrome types. The pinned @types/chrome 0.1.31 does declare chrome.browserAction, so the stated reason is false and the cast can be removed. Use api?.browserAction instead of weakening the staged lint enforcement required by AGENTS.md rule 6.
findings.failureMode: The diff suppresses the existing mandatory noExplicitAny error despite the repository's pinned types providing the API; it weakens lint enforcement and leaves an incorrect justification in source.
findings.title: Do not suppress the lint check for an already typed API

findings.description: `True` is not declared or imported, so the web type-check job fails with TS2304 (`Cannot find name 'True'`). This check runs for every web change in `.github/workflows/style.yml`; the catch block does not suppress compiler diagnostics. Replace it with the JavaScript boolean `true`.
findings.failureMode: Running the registered web TypeScript check fails with TS2304 on `return True`, blocking the Web Style CI job.
findings.title: Return a defined JavaScript value

findings.description: Clearing a JSON-object field's schema now persists `json_schema: undefined`, but `StartNode._validate_and_normalize_json_object_inputs` skips JSON parsing when there is no schema. A valid input like `{"age":20}` is consequently emitted as a string rather than an object, breaking downstream object inputs. Make JSON-object normalization independent of the optional schema so clearing validation does not change the runtime value type.
findings.failureMode: Clear a schema on a JSON-object Start input and execute with `{"age":20}`; the Start output becomes a string instead of an object and object-consuming downstream nodes get the wrong type.
findings.title: Keep JSON-object outputs typed when clearing the schema

findings.description: Deleting `properties: v` removes the only read of `const v = JSON.parse(value)`. The handler now leaves a nontrivial dead store, violating AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md rule 17 and the configured `sonarjs/no-dead-store` error. Keep the parse check as `JSON.parse(value)` without assigning it to `v`.
findings.failureMode: The removal of the parsed value's only use makes the schema handler fail the mandatory SonarJS no-dead-store lint check.
findings.title: Remove the now-unused parsed-schema binding

findings.description: `normalizedJsonSchema` is initialized but never read; `payloadToSave` separately repeats the normalization. This violates AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md rule 17's ban on SonarJS dead stores and fails the configured `sonarjs/no-dead-store` lint rule. Remove the unused binding.
findings.failureMode: The new unused normalization binding violates the mandatory no-dead-store rule and can fail the web lint check.
findings.title: Remove the unused schema normalization binding

findings.description: The added `if (schema?.type !== 'object')` is nested inside an else-if, another if, and a try, exceeding the configured SonarJS `nested-control-flow` limit of three levels. This violates AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md rule 17. Extract the schema validation into a helper or use early returns to keep the nesting within that limit.
findings.failureMode: The added schema type check produces a new `sonarjs/nested-control-flow` warning, violating the repository's mandatory SonarJS rules.
findings.title: Reduce schema-validation nesting

findings.description: `setUpApp()` now executes before `setUpExperimentVariables()`, but it passes the initially nil `jsonFileName` and `featureName` implicitly unwrapped properties to `addLaunchArgument`'s nonoptional String parameters. A suite relying on the documented setup hook traps before the hook can populate them. Restore the hook call before `setUpApp()`.
findings.failureMode: Invoking FeatureFlaggedTestSuite's async setup with experiment properties initialized through setUpExperimentVariables crashes on nil IUO conversion in setUpApp.
findings.title: Initialize experiment variables before using them

findings.description: `IpadOnlyTestCase.setUp()` awaits the new throwing `BaseTestCase.setUp()` without `try`. Swift rejects the call, so the XCUITests target cannot compile. Use `try await super.setUp()` as in the iPhone counterpart.
findings.failureMode: Building the XCUITests target produces 'call can throw but is not marked with try' at the iPad super.setUp call.
findings.title: Propagate the throwing iPad setup call

findings.description: Changing the lifecycle overrides to async leaves `forceRestartApp()` calling the inherited synchronous XCTest methods, which do not terminate/relaunch the app or rebuild the navigator. `AuthenticationTest.testBasicHTTPAuthenticationPromptVisibleAndLogin` now checks persistence without restarting, allowing a false pass; the bookmark helper also retains its old navigator. Make `forceRestartApp()` async throws and await both lifecycle overrides, updating its callers accordingly.
findings.failureMode: The existing forceRestartApp calls do not restart the app/reset navigation after the lifecycle overrides become async.
findings.title: Migrate synchronous restart callers

findings.description: The deleted `// This Source Code Form is subject to the terms of the Mozilla Public` header is not replaced; the file now starts with `import XCTest`. This violates AGENTS.md rule 1 and the enabled `file_header` SwiftLint rule. Restore the standard three-line MPL header before the import.
findings.failureMode: A11yUtils.swift lacks the required MPL v2 header at the beginning of every Swift file, failing repository licensing/lint compliance.
findings.title: Restore the MPL header

findings.description: When workspaceId/adminToken enable JWT auth, _generateToken() returns {token, exp}, so this stores a wrapper object where getToken().token must be a string. The server stats client consequently builds `Authorization: Bearer [object Object]`, and the admin token endpoint also returns a nested token object. This breaks JWT-backed analytics on every request; cache tokenData.token instead. The same correction also restores expiry checks/caching.
findings.failureMode: JWT-enabled analytics requests receive a nested token object rather than a signed JWT and fail authentication; cached tokens are regenerated on each call.
findings.title: Cache the signed JWT string, not the token wrapper

findings.description: `@tinybird/cli` is not published in the npm registry (its metadata endpoint returns 404), so the documented installation exits with E404 before developers can use Tinybird. The repository already provides `yarn tb:install` and a Docker CLI; document the supported installer rather than this nonexistent package.

findings.description: An API plan missing expiration_date now inserts tenant_id: None into a mapping whose contract promises SubscriptionPlan values. findings.description: The required basedpyright check reports 'TypedDict classes can contain only type annotations' at this method, blocking the Python Style job. SubscriptionPlan values are plain dicts, so the override is not used at runtime either; it also violates rule 21's restriction on unnecessary dunder overrides. Remove __str__ from the TypedDict and use a separate formatting helper if needed.

findings.description: With REDIS_USE_CLUSTERS enabled, tenant_plan:<tenant_id> keys normally hash to different slots. Redis Cluster MGET requires a single slot, so a multi-tenant read fails and the fallback fetches every tenant from the billing API even after the cache is populated. Use the cluster-safe non-atomic bulk read or pipelined GETs for this supported Redis mode.
findings.failureMode: Configured RedisCluster and two cached tenant plans in different hash slots: mget raises a cross-slot error and the billing API is called for both instead of serving the cached plans.
findings.title: Use a cross-slot-safe bulk read for Redis Cluster

findings.description: The new cache-validation path uses the existing TypedDict adapter, which silently accepts and drops undeclared fields. A cached plan with an unexpected_field is treated as a hit rather than rejected. AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md rule 14 requires Pydantic v2 DTO validation with ConfigDict(extra='forbid') by default. Validate cached plans through a model configured to forbid extras and preserve the mapping return contract.
findings.failureMode: Cached JSON containing plan, expiration_date and an undeclared field validates successfully and bypasses the API fallback, contrary to the mandatory forbid-extras DTO validation rule.
findings.title: Forbid undeclared fields in cached plan validation

findings.description: For a mismatched MGET response length, this service raises a bare Exception. AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md rule 15 requires domain-specific exceptions from services/errors or core/errors. Use a billing/cache-specific exception for this guard, preserving the API fallback.

findings.description: A Redis read failure is recovered by fetching plans from the API, but this call emits an error-level exception without tenant identifiers. findings.description: With platform-certs enabled and a system-installed corporate CA, webview2_guid_path uses PlatformVerifier and can complete its HEAD request, but this uncached installer GET uses ureq's default WebPki roots. It rejects the same certificate and aborts NSIS/MSI bundling in offlineInstaller mode. Restore `download(url)?` for the GET so it uses the configured agent too.
findings.failureMode: System-CA-only TLS trust succeeds for WebView2 discovery but fails for the subsequent installer download.
findings.title: Use the configured agent for the offline WebView2 download

findings.description: Building tauri-bundler (or tauri-cli, which forwards this feature) with `--no-default-features --features platform-certs` enables only ureq/platform-verifier. In the locked ureq 3.0.3 that feature does not enable its `_tls`/rustls features, so `ureq::tls` and the builder's `tls_config` method used by the new feature-gated code do not exist and compilation fails. Make platform-certs also enable the rustls/TLS backend it configures.
findings.failureMode: Selecting the new platform-certs feature without default features fails compilation because its ureq TLS APIs are not enabled.
findings.title: Enable the TLS implementation required by platform-certs

findings.description: Removing the await from `await featureOptInService.setUserFeatureState({` detaches validation and persistence from the request, so the endpoint reports success even when they fail. findings.description: Each new For expression becomes a strong key in a process-wide cache. Razor expressions such as () => Input.Email capture their component/model, so disposed forms and circuits remain reachable; rerenders also add new entries. An isolated run retained all 1,000 captured models after GC and released them only after ClearCache. Avoid caching expression instances or use weak keys to prevent unbounded memory growth and eventual process exhaustion.
findings.failureMode: Repeated form rendering/disposal leaves all captured components and models reachable from _memberInfoCache, accumulating until the Blazor process exhausts memory.
findings.title: Do not retain accessor expressions in a static cache
